violet-cs: Planning a short reserved-capacity warmup for Dynamo ahead of renewal — need quota plan, priming script, and 90m rollback. Target p95 < 350ms, cost delta <12%. Tentative Thu 11:00 PT.
raj-eng: I can allocate pool-61 (3x A100). Will confirm whitelisted IPs and provide warm IPs. Need expected qps/tokens.
tom-ops: Proposed run: seed 6k tokens, shadow 10% for 15m, ramp to 80% for 30m, full soak 45m, then cool-down. Abort if p95 > 500ms for 3m or gpu_util > 90% for 5m.
sasha-sre: Autoscale: min=2, target_util=0.66, max=12. Enable batch_floor=8. Add routing fallback to q4_0_small at p95>800ms for 2m.
infra-bot: autoscale policy applied to pool-61: {"min":2,"target_util":0.66,"max":12} :white_check_mark:
violet-cs: I'll capture enablement notes and send 3-qs post-run survey to Dynamo ops. Raj — please confirm whitelists. Tom — leave 90m rollback window and post a short run summary in this thread.
